Nevermind, I can't repro the crash in dev2 either, will need a proper bisect

My bisect failed to find the culprit, after fail to bisect (i was testing playing the project direct instead open the editor and play) and seems that my crash in 4.6 dev 3 was another bug as i can't open the project in the editor when the rendering driver is `d3d12`. 

Changing the rendering driver to vulkan i retested the project again and now crashes on 4.6 dev 5 (and i can open the project with the editor using `d3d12` so the bug from dev 3 was fixed) so now looks i'm in the correct path. I'll bisect again.
Two hours and a failed bisect later, bisected to commit 090a4540b7b708f9c8acf8edac4f56888188bc6d from PR #86079 as the culprit. CC @dsnopek

@dsnopek Exactly what is causing the issue is this line:

```
static_body.add_child.call_deferred(occluder_polygon)
```

`occluder_polygon` is a resource, so it shouldn't be possible to add it as a child. In fact if you change the line to 

```
static_body.add_child(occluder_polygon)
```

You get a GDScript error as expected:
```
Error at (18, 27): Invalid argument for "add_child()" function: argument 1 should be "Node" but is "OccluderPolygon2D".
```


When running in older versions of Godot we get:

```

```

I can reproduce a crash with that simple script:
```gdscript
extends Node

func _ready():
    var res = Resource.new()
    add_child(res)
```
